09 / GOOD TO KNOW

FREQUENTLY
ASKED QUESTIONS.

Still have a question? Contact the team ↗

What ages can join outdoor track & field?

The 2027 outdoor track & field interest meeting is for athletes ages 5–14. Ask our team about specific eligibility for other programs.

Do athletes need previous experience?

Families with both new and experienced athletes are welcome to inquire. Our coaches can explain expectations and the appropriate next steps.

Where and when are practices?

Current practice locations and times will be confirmed by the team as the season approaches. Request the latest details through the interest form.

How much does the program cost?

Fees, included gear, and payment details depend on the program and season. Contact FS NextGen for the current package before making plans.

How can families ask about tutoring or counseling?

Select Tutoring or Mental Health Counseling in the interest form. Availability and next steps will need to be confirmed by FS NextGen. Please do not include private health details; this form is not for emergencies.

When will Team Store items arrive? What if my order is late?

FS NextGen guarantees delivery within 14 calendar days after payment confirmation. If an order has not been delivered by that deadline, the club will issue a full refund of the amount paid. Contact FS NextGen through the website with your order details; do not send payment-card information. Refunds are handled by the club through Stripe, not automatically by this website.

Can I buy FS NextGen team gear on this website?

You can select team gear, sizes, and colors. Secure online card checkout will become available when products, prices, fulfillment, and the team’s Stripe account are approved. Stripe securely processes payments; card numbers are never entered on the FS NextGen website.

Does submitting interest reserve a roster spot?

No. The inquiry lets you start a conversation with the team. Participation, registration, and roster availability require separate confirmation.
